findings: Actual signed DEX compares numeric signed-module versions. Same/lower package retains verified installed generation; incomplete newer installed state is not downgraded.
A higher signed module generation is needed for forward recovery, not only a higher Android versionCode.
Source/DEX retain preflight of old/new known files, backups and signature/manifest publication last; unknown local source edits remain blocking.

Installer does not remove obsolete source files. Recovery must establish that retained candidate helper files are unreferenced and cannot pass the older functional module allowlist. No user-data cleanup is authorized.
Skin update/install-over selection still requires verification on actual Android; version metadata is proposed, not a claim of runtime success.
